# honorific

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:honorific`](gmeow-honorific.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/honorific>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An honorific/title of address for a person (a [`gmeow:Honorific`](../classes/gmeow-Honorific.md) value). Non-functional and contextual. A form of ADDRESS, sex/gender-independent — MUST NOT be inferred from gender identity/expression, sex-assigned-at-birth or orientation.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record an honorific or title of address a person goes by — a form of address, contextual and possibly multiple ([`gmeow:honorificMx`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificMx.md), [`gmeow:honorificDr`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificDr.md), [`gmeow:honorificSayyid`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificSayyid.md), …).

### Avoid when

- Avoid inferring it from, or asserting it to imply, gender identity, gender expression, sex assigned at birth, or orientation — address is not identity; and avoid making it functional, since it is a co-equal facet ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Attach a [`gmeow:Honorific`](../classes/gmeow-Honorific.md) value to a person with [`gmeow:honorific`](gmeow-honorific.md) (non-functional); the title's render placement and domain come from [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](gmeow-honorificPosition.md) and [`gmeow:honorificClass`](gmeow-honorificClass.md) on the value.

### Examples

- ex:person [`gmeow:honorific`](gmeow-honorific.md) [`gmeow:honorificDr`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificDr.md).
